notes.title: Minor update 1.05.69
notes.content: -Vika now scores less points in dance.

notes.title: Minor update 1.04.69
notes.content:
-Increased starting reputation with Vika (4>>5).
-Decreased starting reputation with Alina (7>>5).
-Decreased final speed in the dancing minigame.
-Decreased hand tremors by ~20%.

-Fixed a bug where, after the first date with Vika, a tray could remain in the player's inventory and could not be dropped.
-Fixed some interaction issues with the sink and plates.
-Other minor fixes.

Sebasa Games

notes.title: Update 1.03.69 Hot-fix
notes.content:
- Fixed some achievement unlocks.

-Added option to run with DirectX11

- Added proper SteamCloud support.

- Improved the restaurant minigame (vegetables now fit on your plate even if you overfill them).

- Slightly simplified the dance difficulty.

- Added a tooltip if you're opening the interface for the first time.

- Added an icon for the game.
